query: I just got back from picking up my new cat from the animal shelter this afternoon, she’s the cutest little tabby with white paws and a tiny pink nose, I’ve already set up a little cat tree by my window so she can watch the birds outside. Oh and I stopped at the bakery on my way home and picked up a matcha scone and a lavender latte, they were both so good I’m already thinking about going back tomorrow to get another one to share with my roommate. My phone isn’t connecting to the internet at all right now, I checked and airplane mode is turned on, my network preference seems to be set wrong, the WiFi calling feature isn’t working properly, I got a notification that I’ve exceeded my monthly data usage limit, I think my SIM card might be unseated, and I’m currently abroad right now and I have roaming turned off so I’m not sure what to do to get my service working again.
